params.name: margin_db
params.why: signal-to-masker ratio inside one auditory filter; M2 scores the count's stability across it

params.name: sigma_scale
params.why: ERB is an equivalent RECTANGULAR bandwidth, not a Gaussian sigma, so sigma = ERB over-masks. Amendment 1's table.

params.name: f_c
params.why: the criterion is a RATIO of amplitudes at one frequency, so it is invariant in f_c up to the ERB width's mild frequency dependence; the field itself is scale-invariant in f_c

params.name: f_range_hz
params.why: partials outside human hearing cannot mask or be masked; the bound only removes terms that contribute nothing

params.name: both_witnesses_required
params.why: a coincidence is two partials landing together, so one audible partial arriving where nothing else is does not fuse

scope: relative masking only: no absolute threshold in quiet, no temporal integration, no binaural effects. Gaussian sigma = ERB over-masks; see amendment 1's width table.
